result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_edge_df()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get edges as a Polars DataFrame with standardized structure. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L7907-L8025){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_edge_df() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Returns all edges with a consistent column structure: - column 1: `id` (i64, mandatory, sorted ascending) - column 2: `source` (i64, mandatory) - column 3: `target` (i64, mandatory) - column 4: `rel` (str, mandatory, null if not set) - columns 5-N: Other attributes (alphabetically sorted) - weight is included as a special attribute if present The DataFrame is always sorted by edge ID in ascending order. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [pl.DataFrame]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A Polars DataFrame with edges sorted by `id`. Returns an empty DataFrame if the graph has no edges. ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} - first 4 columns always: `id`, `source`, `target`, `rel` (in that order) - missing `rel` values appear as `None` - other attributes are sorted alphabetically - DataFrame sorted by `id` ascending - `weight` treated as a special attribute column ## Examples {.doc-examples} Export edges to DataFrame: ::: {#b81b478a .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node("A") .add_node("B") .add_node("C") .add_node("D") .add_edge("A", "B", weight=1.5, rel="friend") .add_edge("B", "C", weight=2.0, rel="colleague") .add_edge("C", "D", weight=1.0, rel="friend") ) df = graph.get_edge_df() # Returns ['id', 'source', 'target', 'rel', 'weight'] df.columns ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` ['id', 'source', 'target', 'rel', 'weight'] ``` ::: ::: ::: {#eaaeb085 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Returns (3, 5) df.shape ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` (3, 5) ``` ::: ::: Filter edges by relationship type: ::: {#ea288ede .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} import polars as pl friends = df.filter(pl.col("rel") == "friend") # Count relationship types rel_counts = df.group_by("rel").count() # Average weight per relationship type avg_by_rel = df.group_by("rel").agg(pl.col("weight").mean()) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` /var/folders/s8/bj_jsx3d7jqd2btw7bwm6yx80000gp/T/ipykernel_2149/1305249973.py:5: DeprecationWarning: `GroupBy.count` was renamed; use `GroupBy.len` instead rel_counts = df.group_by("rel").count() ``` ::: :::
